Gemma compares every request with your agreed deliverables and limits.

02 / Inspect

YOUR CLIENT DATA STAYS WITH YOU

Bring your own laptop.

The live app uses Python, local SQLite and Gemma through Ollama. After setup and model download, the app has no cloud AI dependency.

Download source & submission kit ↓
  1. Install Python 3.10+ and Ollama.
  2. Download the model once.
  3. Unzip the source and start the app.
ollama pull gemma3:4b
python3 server.py
# Open http://127.0.0.1:8765

Gemma 4B still makes scope errors. Inspect each source and override any wrong decision. Model downloads and first inference need time and several GB of memory.
